walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the Edexcel GCSE Design Technology specification.

Industry & Manufacturing appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Industry & Manufacturing in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Edexcel board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Industry & Manufacturing.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
